name: Kyoritsu Maintenance Co., Ltd.
summary: Kyoritsu Maintenance Co., Ltd. operates dormitories for students and companies. The company operates through Dormitory Business, Hotel business, Comprehensive Building Management Business, Foods Business, Development Business, and other segments.
